tools.name: next_bank_holidays
tools.description: FREE. Next 3 UK bank holidays for a nation, plus whether today is a working day.

tools.name: working_days
tools.description: PRO. Count UK working days between two dates (excludes weekends + bank holidays for the nation).

tools.name: due_date
tools.description: PRO. Invoice/contract due date: add N working days or N calendar days (rolled to next working day) to a date. Includes Late Payment Act 30-day default.

tools.name: tax_deadlines
tools.description: PRO. Upcoming HMRC and Companies House deadlines for the next N months; add company_year_end for Corporation Tax, CT600 and accounts dates.

tools.name: month_planner
tools.description: PRO. For a month: working days count, bank holidays, payday suggestions (last working day / 25th rolled back) and deadlines.

tools.name: news_quick
tools.description: FREE. Quick news & facts lookup for a topic: top Wikipedia matches (with summary) and top Hacker News stories from the last 30 days. No key.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: PRO ($0.01). Search worldwide online news (GDELT DOC 2.0, 65+ languages) for a topic: latest articles with headline, URL, outlet domain, time seen and source country. Options: days (1-90, default 7), uk_only, lang (e.g. english), max (≤50).

tools.name: tech_news_search
tools.description: PRO ($0.01). Search Hacker News stories (via Algolia) for a company, product or topic: title, link, points, comments. Options: days (default 30), min_points, sort ('relevance' or 'recent'), max (≤30).

tools.name: facts_search
tools.description: PRO ($0.01). Wikipedia search for background facts: up to 10 matching articles with snippets, and summaries for the top 3.

tools.name: news_briefing
tools.description: PRO ($0.01). One-call briefing on a company or topic: latest GDELT news (optionally UK outlets only), Hacker News discussion and Wikipedia background.
